skill.name: creativity
skill.description: Transforms raw prompts and abstract problems into feasible creative concepts through analogies, synthesis, and reality checks.
skill.summary: Generates and refines creative solution concepts using structured analogical thinking.
skill.author: joeloffbeat

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. Manual review found no evidence of prompt injection, credential access, code execution, or network behavior.

content.value_statement: Blank prompts and complex problems can lead to predictable ideas. This skill structures creative thinking through analogy, synthesis, and feasibility checks.
actual_capabilities: Deconstructs prompts into purpose, process, and desired output.
Reframes complex requests into a clear functional essence.
Uses analogies from distant domains to generate options.
Synthesizes viable analogies into prototype narratives.
Scores ideas for feasibility and utility before finalizing.
Shapes final answers around simple, concrete, and credible stories.
limitations: It does not execute code or validate ideas with live market data.
Generated concepts may need review by a domain expert.
Weak input context can produce broad or generic ideas.
Memory use depends on approved connectors and user consent.

use_cases.title: Create Product Concepts
use_cases.description: Turn vague customer problems into concrete product directions with clear feasibility checks.

use_cases.title: Build Campaign Angles
use_cases.description: Find unexpected but credible messaging angles by comparing a market challenge to distant systems.

use_cases.title: Refine Research Ideas
use_cases.description: Convert abstract observations into prototype narratives that can guide experiments or proposals.

prompt_templates.title: Reframe a Problem
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for clarifying a vague challenge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the creativity skill on this challenge: [challenge]. Identify the why, how, and what. Then state the functional essence.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Distant Analogies
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for expanding the idea space.
prompt_templates.prompt: Take this functional essence: [essence]. Generate five analogies from biology, machines, history, architecture, and social systems.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize a Prototype
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for turning analogies into a usable idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the strongest analogy from this list: [analogies]. Convert it into one prototype narrative with benefits and risks.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Reality Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for selecting and improving ideas.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these concepts: [concepts]. Score feasibility and utility from 1 to 10. Refine the strongest concept into an action plan.

output_examples.input: Challenge: Make onboarding for a data tool feel less intimidating.
output: Functional essence: Build trust before asking for commitment.
Analogy: A museum audio guide offers context before the visitor explores alone.
Prototype: A guided first project explains each step and shows progress after every action.

output_examples.input: Prompt: Create a launch angle for a privacy dashboard.
output_examples.output: The strongest angle is a home safety check for personal data. Users see open windows, trusted doors, and clear actions.

output_examples.input: Prompt: Improve an abstract idea for a community learning tool.
output: Feasibility: 7 of 10 because the workflow can start with simple templates.
Utility: High because members need repeatable ways to share lessons.
Refinement: Start with one reusable lesson card before building a full library.

best_practices: Start with a clear challenge, audience, and desired outcome.
Ask for several analogies before choosing one concept.
Run the reality audit before presenting the final idea.
anti_patterns: Using the skill as a substitute for expert validation.
Requesting only one idea without exploring alternatives.
Storing sensitive user details in optional memory systems.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps turn abstract problems into creative, feasible solution concepts.

faq.question: Can it write final copy?
faq.answer: It can shape messages, but it is strongest for ideation and concept refinement.

faq.question: Does it use code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill is prompt-only and includes no executable files.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What input works best?
faq.answer: Provide the challenge, target audience, constraints, and the type of output needed.

faq.question: How should memory be handled?
faq.answer: Use memory connectors only when approved, and avoid storing sensitive user information.
